title: Understanding Star Schema
text: In a star schema, the dimension tables are used to store attributes related to the facts in the fact table. They do not contain relationships between different facts.

title: Role of Dimension Tables
text: Dimension tables provide descriptive information for the facts in the fact table, such as time, location, or product details.

title: Correct Statement Identification
